title: Sprint planning dry-runs every paid run a goal names and sets its cap from the estimate before the start gate
goal: When a committed item's goal names a paid run with a spend cap (a smoke record, a probe), plan step 6 runs its --dry-run on the planning host and records the estimate in the item's notes; a cap below the estimate is a gate asked before the start, not mid-run. SP-2vhfsn4o: ST-xy5kmisr's goal said --max-usd 5 for a command whose dry run estimated 23.37 USD; the gate came after the code, and the first smoke still spent 26.62 against a 23.37 estimate
notes: SP-x7ger6vu close (2026-10-09), accepted by the operator: three mid-run surprises a planning run of the goal's paid commands would have shown: the router-only re-record left pool verify (c) failing on the full record's spend row (ST-4w4yo6ca joined the sprint mid-run); host-lookups has no effort setting, so ST-fbp5pm6k's 'both levels in one batch' needed gate g2 mid-run; and benchmarks.py run SCENARIO --dry-run starts paid runs outside pool (BG-wapzksub), so the plan's estimate must come from a scenario that honours it. The planning run uses each paid command's real flags and simulates a partial re-record against pool verify. Merged from ST-tqmayy2h “Planning estimates the runtime and spend of a goal's paid runs before the start gate” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Near-duplicate of ST-um56cyur (similar 0.67): plan step estimates a paid run before the start gate. ST-um56cyur must also record run count, sequential runtime and spend at claude/models.csv prices in notes, and add the spend-cap gate and any parallel-run story. Its goal: The /kb-sprint plan step that reviews committed goals records, for an item whose goal runs paid model calls (a benchmark record), the run count, the sequential runtime and the spend at each pinned model's current prices (claude/models.csv) in its notes, with the command that estimated them (a dry run), and asks the spend cap gate and adds any parallel-run story before the start gate; found by the SP-hm4qgf3t close: ST-ji32ouga's record was sized only during the run (3,150 runs, 20-30 h sequential), so ST-uxgaazfi was filed mid-sprint, and its gate g3 (about 140 USD against the 120 USD cap once Sonnet 5.5's price was used) was asked mid-work. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='paid model calls' in t;print('plan step sizes paid runs:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"]} Its touches: .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md, kb/_self/backlog.md
